must_not_flag.why: Posted: [logic-inversion] Empty failing suite is skipped, not reported — The comment says a suite's own conclusion is a result only when the suite carries no runs, but the condition requires the opposite: `!suiteCarriesRuns(suite)` is false whenever runs exist, so a suite that carries runs never contributes its own conclusion. A lone non-container check that concluded FAILURE and produced no runs is dropped from Failing entirely. Refuted: `!suiteCarriesRuns(suite)` is true exactly when the suite has no runs — the case the comment describes. The finding inverted the negation ("false whenever runs exist" is true but irrelevant) and concluded the opposite.
